verdict: Paid ads not yet live; organic traffic holding steady while launch prep completes.
narrative: No paid campaigns ran this period — Meta and Google Ads carried zero spend across the full 28 days, as renewal work that began August 1 is still moving through pre-launch steps. Your Google Business Profile drove 413 actions over the 28-day window, though activity dropped sharply in the last 7 days; we're monitoring whether this reflects a visibility issue or a short-term dip in local search demand. Website traffic remained broadly flat despite zero paid traffic, with organic and direct sources sustaining over 7,300 sessions this period. Several key milestones land today — funnel testing, UTM tracking, and SEO guardrails — which clear the path for campaigns to go live. Purchase data is not reporting reliably due to a known tracking issue being repaired, so that number under-reports actual sales.

website sessions this period, held steady on organic and direct traffic alone
paid ad spend this period — campaigns are in final pre-launch setup and not yet live

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement fell 84% in the last 7 days, dropping to near zero on the final two days of the period — a confirmed short-term signal being investigated for a listing visibility issue.
watch_item.fix: The listing is being reviewed this week to confirm it is fully active and correctly categorized, so any visibility problem is caught before campaigns launch.
